attempts.summary: Forced node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic through node1 then node2 via host/static routes on what was actually a flat subnet; configured VyOS (node1) to permit+log via an nftables accept rule with logging, and OPNsense (node2) to refuse+log via a pf block rule inserted ahead of the default LAN-allow rule. Fixed an ICMP-redirect issue (disabled send-redirects on node1) that was letting node3 bypass node1's path. Verified matching, IP-ID-correlated log pairs (permit at node1, block at node2) from single attempts, both before and after the mandatory restart sequence on all four nodes.
